_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Mary went with haste into the hill country.
And the child leaped in Elizabeth's womb.
Blessed are you among women.
And blessed is the fruit of your womb.
My soul magnifies the Lord.
My spirit rejoices in God my Savior.
He has lifted up the lowly. Come, let us worship.
My soul magnifies the Lord!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Watch two women meet on a hillside, one old and one young, both carrying impossible promises.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
At the sound of the greeting the child in Elizabeth leaps for joy, and the old woman cries out a blessing.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
And Mary sings the song the poor have always sung: the proud are scattered, the hungry are filled, the lowly are lifted up.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
He raises the poor from the dust and seats them with princes; he has remembered his promise of old.
My soul magnifies the Lord!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Two women meet, both carrying God's promise.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
The child leaps for joy at Mary's greeting.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
He fills the hungry and lifts up the lowly.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
Come, let us sing with Mary.
My soul magnifies the Lord!
